independence: pressure consistency, sparse equivalence/capacity and physical preservation have separate gates; no historical decision is edited

physics.fit: physical z<=25mm;f3a_R ids0,1,2 equal; fixed normalization and u_tau/Uinf=.051; no calibration change
physics.inner: finite molecular nu, transported nonconstant k, endpoint-state-dependent coefficients/cutoff and frozen prescribed sink, dependent epsilon
physics.boundary: AcceptedRichardsNorrisFlatV1; natural physical top fluxes and absolute nonlinear outlet traction
physics.method: consistent-free-mass single PIMPLE sweep, same stage/history/trace treatment
physics.prohibited: restoration, mean subtraction for admission, reference cancellation, clipping/floors, post-k repair, extra governing sweeps

pressure.strip: unchanged 2957-slot P4/P2 mesh, physical functions, projection, raw/effective/boundary identity and quadrature
pressure.continuation: only on complete new-pair primitives; same dt and method; no additional halving if failed
pressure.diagnostics: sealed first flow blocks A,G,D,C,M,actual rm/rc, history/lift, native split and exact coupled diagnostic correction, conditional alpha-limit, whole/inner/outer pressure directions and tractions; no diagnostic solve feeds evolution
pressure.quad_states: actual initial and .001 terminal state at identical coefficients; alpha0 governing residual, separate from field-observation quadrature

backend.scope: serial affine flat2D Original Natural A95 displaced Accepted/RN one-sweep, cacheOff, no bound/action/research routes
backend.zero_displacement_verification: explicit flag and <=1000 stored slots; A95 Accepted/RN only; not a production extension
backend.storage: deterministic sorted sparse row assembly then CSR, no global dense staging; local assembly accumulation order retained
backend.predictor_scalars: Eigen SparseLU direct; actual residual recomputed
backend.consistent_mass: Eigen sparse positive LDLT direct; no lumping in governing action; true action residual independently measured
backend.pressure: installed Nektar GMRES with right preconditioning and FlexibleGMRES=1; matrix-free D[(alpha M_free)^-1 Gp]-Cp; direct consistent mass makes the action fixed apart from roundoff
backend.preconditioner: sparse LU of D diag(M_free)^-1 G-C; diagonal mass ONLY in this named preconditioner
backend.snapshot: CSR/action/vectors/hashes on larger cases; mandatory physical inventories retained; backend-bound restart, no cross-backend relabelling

equivalence.fixtures: CT7 A95 d0 P3/P1,P4/P2 and CT8 displaced539/945; strip2957 physical .002/.001 cohorts
equivalence.dense_failed_classification: sparse must reproduce CT8 temporal:Pi within solve-error budget, not convert backend success to preservation admission

capacity.radial: exact CT8 target grid, including its declared collar/transition nodes; any representation amendment requires new pre-evolution version
capacity.levels: intermediate CT8 X[::4] plus final endpoint, full P3/P1, full P4/P2
capacity.scope: initial projection, assembly, actions/solves, norms and mandatory physical preflight; no over-limit dense solve; mapped terrain fields/evolution unsupported
capacity.measure: nnz,fill, allocations/RSS, exclusive startup/assembly/mass/pressure/scalar CPU, true residuals, output volume

prerequisites: measured resource preflight supports finite campaign
preservation.time_pair: freeze in a prospective target-admission receipt from actual mesh/step costs, not inherited solely from strip
preservation.resource_admission: predeclare finite target step,CPU/wall,storage/checkpoint ceilings after measured static/step cost and before trajectory; absent prerequisites means explicitly unexecuted
